appearance_facts.fact: A light-orange wedge labeled 'Apple (60 %)' occupies the largest visible angular span, roughly from the 12 o'clock position counter-clockwise to about the 9-10 o'clock position.
A dark-red wedge labeled 'Xiaomi (10 %)' is the smallest of the four named wedges, spanning roughly from 12 o'clock clockwise to about 3-4 o'clock.
An orange-red wedge labeled 'Samsung (12 %)' sits at the bottom, spanning roughly from 4 o'clock to 7 o'clock.
A pale-yellow wedge labeled 'Others (18 %)' occupies the left side, spanning roughly from 7 o'clock to 9-10 o'clock.
Title text 'Smartphone Market Share in Europe' appears in black serif font.

printed_facts.fact: Region scope printed as 'Europe'; metric is market share in percent.

public_definitions: Premium promotion rule: Select the brand with the highest current market_share
Routing: the next premium retail promotion is reserved for the current European market leader
